recipe.source: G7-derived cleaned volumetric finish accepted by user
recipe.phase: Reuse exact whole_field.py FINE analytic phase, profile, modulation and PCHIP envelope; no new MIDDLE geometry.
recipe.actual_source_normal: Unit mean of actual incident triangle unit normals; no normal/shading map.
recipe.current_feature_policy: No inherited feature_support exists on remesh; do not substitute or claim old support. Instead attenuate where incident normals disagree.
recipe.coherence_attenuation: smoothstep(clip((coherence-.75)/.20,0,1)); hard or folded-back junctions attenuated, smooth faces retain amplitude.
recipe.reflection: Actual clean mirror_x/y_vertex_pairs; frozen _transport; exact source ID topology retained.
recipe.curvature_amplitude_cap: B=.10*incident_mean_triangle_edge_length/sqrt(max(2*(1-coherence),1e-12)); signed <- B*tanh(signed/B). This is a local geometric radius proxy, not certified principal curvature/reach.
recipe.orientation_limiter: If source-relative triangle reversal remains, union its incident vertex IDs across actual X/Y orbits, zero new displacement there, feather by four incident-face scalar mean iterations, reset core zero each time. At most three limiter updates; no source XYZ averaging.
recipe.scope: One authored low-amplitude whole-column relief. Analytic theta/height phase gives mostly longitudinal direction; it does not track every actual material fold, restore old chart/feature ancestry, or add branching ornament.

topology_check_scope: Exact unchanged triangle array inherits proven closed connected oriented edge graph and no orphans; all current output positions/triangle areas and relative orientation checked.
